risk_note: Admin 用户详情 union binding row actions (apps/admin pages/users/**, texts/users.ts). Contract CT-02j adminResetUserUnionBinding, adminDisableUserUnionBinding, adminEnableUserUnionBinding; backend F1-07c merged. The 操作 column appears only with union.binding_reset or union.binding_disable; 【重置授权】 only on taobao rows that are active / invalid (binding_reset), 【停用返利】 on active / invalid rows and 【恢复】 only on blocked rows with blocked_reason admin_disable (binding_disable; greyed out with a note while the user is banned). Reason required (trimmed, 1-200) with a rule-stating hint; a totp step-up for every write through the shared verified-write hook; body only reason and expected_row_version, no Idempotency-Key, no identity fields; 20902 / 30154 refresh the detail and a failed refresh shows a could-not-refresh notice; double click sends once. Prerequisite test-change F1-07ja (#2029) merged; no frozen test changed here. Rule tests written by an independent Claude in two rounds; Claude spec-test review r1 fail (1 S1, 1 S2), r2 pass (3 S2 carried into the implementation constraints); red on the test machine (red/1-2). Implementation by Opus 5.5 with a small round 2 for the money review S2; the rebase conflict with F1-07jb (UserDetailView imports, texts blocks) was merged by the orchestrator keeping both sides; test machine verify-fast and browser green after rebasing on main. Adversarial money review by fresh independent Claude: r1 pass (one S2, fixed), r2 incremental pass with no findings. Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 pass with one S2 (a failed refresh after 20902 / 30154 was swallowed; fixed in implementation round 2), round 2 incremental pass with no findings including the rebase conflict merge; independent Claude because Codex is unavailable until 2026-11-02

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagents: round 1 fail (1 S1 reason hint counted the character counter; 1 S2 confirm phrases rejected the board wording), round 2 pass with three S2 carried into the implementation constraints; tests written by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh)

longrun.note: PROP_RUNS=1000000 PROP_SEED=20261001; packages/money and test/properties are unchanged from main
